description_en: Queries the execution status of a task
description_zh: 可以查看任务的执行状态
name: DescribeEndpointSwitchStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This value is returned after you successfully call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201858.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，成功调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201858.html接口后会返回该值
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the task. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Initializing: initializing.
Switching: switching.
Failed: failed.
Finished: succeeded
Status.description_zh:
任务执行状态，返回为：

NotStarted：未启动。
Initializing：初始化中。
Switching：切换中。
Failed：执行失败。
Finished：执行成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
